steps: Cook the guanciale slowly until crisp; keep the fat.
Whisk the yolks, egg and pecorino with lots of pepper.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water until just al dente.
Toss the pasta in the pan off the heat, then stir in the egg mix with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Soften the onion and pepper in the oil.
Add garlic and spices for a minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover until the whites set.
Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a tin.
Whisk sugar, eggs and zest until pale.
Stream in the oil, then the juice.
Fold in flour, baking powder and salt.
Warm the stock with soy and mirin.
Assemble with eggs, spring onions and nori.
